_comment_reconnect: Auto-reconnect stays OFF unless you explicitly set this true (or pass --auto-reconnect) - see README.md for why.
_comment_activitylog: ActivityLogPath/ActivityLogMaxEntries are left out on purpose: omitting them keeps the shared default (%LOCALAPPDATA%\VpnWatchdog\activity-log.db, cap 5000), which is what lets the GUI and CLI append to one history. There is no environment-variable expansion for a value you set here, so if you do override this, use a fully resolved literal path.
